# Resource: okta_behavior_velocity

The Behavior Rules API provides operations to manage the behavior detection rules for your organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Behavior Detection Rule
- `type` (String) Discriminator field identifying the variant type. Must be set to "VELOCITY".

### Optional

- `settings` (Block, Optional) Settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--settings))
- `status` (String) Status

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the resource.
